name: Online Retail
description: Transactional data set containing all transactions occurring between 01/12/2010 and 09/12/2011 for a UK-based and registered non-store online retailer. The company mainly sells unique all-occasion gifts; many customers are wholesalers.
conditionsOfAccess: Open access, no registration required; attribution required under CC BY 4.0.

citation.name: Data mining for the online retail industry: A case study of RFM model-based customer segmentation using data mining
author: Daqing Chen
Sai Laing Sain
Kun Guo
citation.isPartOf: Journal of Database Marketing and Customer Strategy Management, Vol. 19, No. 3

distribution.name: online+retail.zip
distribution.description: ZIP archive distributed by UCI. It contains one file, Online Retail.xlsx.

spatialCoverage.name: Customer locations under 38 country labels (United Kingdom 91.43% of rows); the retailer is UK-based

variableMeasured.name: InvoiceNo
variableMeasured.description: Text. Documented as a 6-digit number per transaction, where a leading 'c' marks a cancellation. Observed: 532,618 rows with 6 digits, 9,288 with prefix C, 3 with prefix A (bad-debt adjustments). Repeats across the lines of one invoice.

variableMeasured.name: StockCode
variableMeasured.description: Text. Documented as a 5-digit product number. Observed: also 5 digits plus letter(s) for variants, and administrative codes such as POST, DOT, M.

variableMeasured.name: Quantity
variableMeasured.description: Integer. Items per invoice line; negative for cancellations and stock adjustments.

variableMeasured.name: InvoiceDate
variableMeasured.description: Date and time (minute precision, time zone not stated) when the transaction was generated.

variableMeasured.name: UnitPrice
variableMeasured.description: Decimal. Price per unit. Observed: 2,515 zero and 2 negative values.

variableMeasured.name: CustomerID
variableMeasured.description: 5-digit identifier of the customer. Observed: 135,080 missing (24.93%), although the repository states that the data have no missing values.

variableMeasured.name: Country
variableMeasured.description: Text. Country where the customer resides. Observed: 38 labels, not standardised (EIRE, RSA, Unspecified, European Community). The cleaned file adds ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

additionalProperty.name: Provenance
additionalProperty.value: Transactions of a UK-based non-store online retailer, 2010-12-01 to 2011-12-09. Donated to the UCI Machine Learning Repository by Daqing Chen, London South Bank University, in 2015. The source business system and extraction process are not documented.
